02 / A little about me

Hi, I’m Emma.
Curious by nature.

I’ve always been fascinated by how surroundings can influence the way we feel, think and experience the world.

Before studying architecture at the School of Explorative Architecture (SEA), I completed a degree in Human Life Sciences at Stellenbosch University. Both have encouraged me to ask questions, look a little closer and think about the relationships between people and their surroundings.

What I enjoy

I’m at my happiest when I’m creating, whether I’m behind a camera, painting, drawing or writing. I enjoy this process as much as the final result, and there’s always something new I want to try, make or learn.

I tend to pay attention to the little things, especially the details that are easy to overlook but can completely change how something comes together.

I also enjoy working through ideas with others. I bring enthusiasm, optimism and an open mind to everything I do, and I believe some of the best ideas come from sharing perspectives and learning from others — something I’ve come to appreciate even more through my student internships at Hours Clear Architects and SAOTA.
